name: Jio Financial Services Ltd.
about: Jio Financial Services Limited, through its subsidiaries, engages in the business of investing and financing, insurance broking, payment bank and payment aggregator, and payment gateway services in India. The company provides loans, savings accounts, recharges, fixed deposits, digital insurance, financial tracking, management tools, digital banking, UPI bill payments, and insurance advisory; and asset and wealth management, and broking services, as well as supply chain and vendor financing and enterprise leasing solutions for devices and cars to corporates, gold, and leasing solutions to individuals and businesses. It also provides insurance broking services, such as car, bike, health, and life insurances. verdict.label: Looks expensive
reasons: Price implies ~37% a year profit growth for 10 years, versus ~25% that history and analysts support (reverse DCF at 10.8% cost of equity).
PE of 90 is near the bottom of its range over the last 3 years (median 131), though that is a short history to judge by.
Trades at PE 90 vs sector median 20; peers with similar ROE and growth trade nearer 57, so the premium is not explained by fundamentals alone.
